patterns.message: src/lib/** cannot import from src/components/, src/layouts/, or src/pages/. Move shared logic or types into src/lib/ (library tests may import scripts/), or move UI-dependent code into src/components/, src/layouts/, or src/pages/. Do not silence with oxlint-disable.

src/components/** cannot import from src/layouts/ or src/pages/. Pass layout or page data and markup via props or <slot /> from src/layouts/ or src/pages/, and put shared helpers or types in src/lib/ or another component under src/components/. Do not silence with oxlint-disable.
